body.statement: For independent \(N_j\sim\operatorname{Pois}(m q_j)\), \(E_q[G_h]=(q_j-z_j)^h\) and \[E_q[G_hG_t]=\sum_{\ell=0}^{\min\{h,t\}}\binom h\ell\binom t\ell\ell!\,(q_j/m)^\ell(q_j-z_j)^{h+t-2\ell}.\] Consequently \(E_q[U_{Q_L}]=Q_L(q-z)\), and \(\operatorname{Var}_q(U_{Q_L})\) is the finite double sum over \(\alpha,\beta\in\mathcal A_{2K,L}\) obtained by multiplying the displayed coordinate second moments and subtracting \(Q_L(q-z)^2\).
body.justification: This identity gives the complete finite covariance calculation for the actual unknown-mass, unknown-logging upper-bound coordinates.
body.gap: JiaoVenkatHanWeissman2015 supplies coordinatewise factorial lifts for additive functionals; the joint ratio maximum requires the full mixed double sum across \(2K\) coordinates.
body.consumer: The certificate can audit the exact variance of every finite candidate table before using it in the full-class estimator.
